privacy.pageDescription: How Relief Hotels & Suites collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you browse our website or make a reservation.

collect.title: Information we collect
collect.body: When you book a stay, request an event quote, or contact us, we collect details you provide — such as your name, email address, phone number, stay dates, and any special requests. Payment references and transaction status are recorded when you pay a deposit through our payment partners.

use.title: How we use your information
use.body: We use your information to confirm reservations, communicate about your stay, process deposits, and improve our hospitality services. Staff may add internal notes to a booking to coordinate arrivals and guest preferences.

share.title: Sharing with service providers
share.body: We share data only with trusted processors needed to operate the website — including hosting (Netlify), database (Supabase), email (Resend), and payment providers (Paystack, Moniepoint). If your hotel enables RAYZA Connect, confirmed booking details may be relayed to your property management system at your request.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Reservation and payment records are kept as long as needed for legal, accounting, and guest-service purposes, then deleted or anonymised when no longer required.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us at reservations@reliefhotelsandsuites.com. We will respond within a reasonable time.

longDescription.guest: Comfortable accommodation with premium bedding, modern amenities, and thoughtful touches for a restful stay. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame Calabar skyline views, while the rain shower and plush linens create a calm retreat after a day of meetings or sightseeing.
longDescription.executive: Designed for business travellers with a dedicated work zone, ergonomic seating, and premium linens. Executive-floor placement offers quieter corridors, Grand Lounge access, and a layout that balances focus time with relaxed evenings.
longDescription.suites: A generously sized suite with separate living space, marble bathroom, and city views. Plush bedding, curated minibar service, and butler assistance elevate celebrations, extended stays, and special occasions in Calabar.
longDescription.presidential: Our finest Penthouse accommodation pairs panoramic views with a separate living room, bespoke butler service, and refined entertaining space. Ideal for diplomatic visits, milestone celebrations, and guests who expect the highest level of privacy and comfort.
longDescription.executiveSpa: Executive-floor accommodation combining a work zone and lounge access with restorative spa credits and wellness dining. In-room amenities support focused business days followed by spa time and unhurried recovery.

Whether you are visiting for business, celebration, or leisure, every stay is shaped around comfort, culture, and calm.
